annotations.title: One site's API recovery scans, newest first: state, how each ended, and findings by weight

description: Wraps GET /api/sites/{slug}/scans. One site's API recovery scans, newest first: state, how each ended, and findings by weight. Call this to see whether a site has been scanned for dead ends (API errors that don't say how to recover, lists without paging, pages nothing links to) and how the last scan came out. Scans are started from the dashboard by an admin or owner.
name: sites_by_slug_scans

ending.description: how it ended: complete, team_stopped, we_stopped, ownership_lost, plan_changed, site_removed, blocked, budget, error

findings.description: findings by weight; null before the report

finishedAt.description: when it finished (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

kind.description: a scan, a free re-scan of a finished one, or a re-run

startedAt.description: when it started (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

state.description: where it is: being quoted, quoted, waiting, running, paused, finished, stopped early or failed

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call

title: One site's API recovery scans, newest first: state, how each ended, and findings by weight
